# 2_extracted_text

The book's text is extracted to the code cache, outside the repo (copyright). This folder keeps only the **sections file** (`<book>.sections.jsonl`): the book's brought-in pages cut into pieces at its own bold headings, each with its section number, title, line ranges, a fingerprint of its words, and the definitions it uses (by the book's italics, R201.1). No words of the book but section titles and defined terms.

**Generated by code only. Never hand-edit.** `python -m document_extraction` reads the brought-in pages (`sources.yaml` `brought_in`) from the cached book, writes the text to the cache and this file here; `--check` fails if either differs from a fresh extraction. Where the cache is missing (CI), it is skipped and says so. How it reads stacked fractions, and how it cuts: `packages/document_extraction/document_extraction/icc.py` and `icc_sections.py`.
